comment: Reference adapter for Claude Code on native Windows (requires Git for Windows, which supplies the bash that runs the .sh hooks/crons). Differs from claude-code.example.json in two places: scheduled-maint uses Windows Task Scheduler (cli.py setup install-memory-schtasks) instead of crontab, and the SessionStart/SessionEnd hook commands are wrapped through Git-bash by np_hook.py's install-hooks (NP_HOOK_WRAP) because Claude Code on Windows runs hook commands via PowerShell by default. The ~/.claude layout (skills/, settings.json) is the same as on Linux. Copy to ~/.config/nervepack/adapter.json (per-machine; not committed).
paths_note: OPTIONAL, and optional per key. Omit the block, or any single key, and nervepack uses its built-in ~/.claude/... default for whatever is missing -- every manifest written before #300 has no paths block and keeps working unchanged. The matching environment variable (CLAUDE_SETTINGS / NP_SKILLS_DST / CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR) still wins over both. A relative value is ignored and reported by the doctor.
